rules: Canonical identity is subject_id + level + curriculum_variant_id, not filename.
A subject shared by several branches is stored once and referenced by branch mappings.
A branch-specific curriculum is represented as a variant under the canonical subject.
PDF and extracted JSON are linked by sha256/source identity; filename similarity alone is insufficient.
Corrections are optional; missing correction is a valid state.
Unknown or low-confidence documents remain pending_review/quarantine.
Duplicate binaries share one canonical document and preserve multiple source records.
